title: niphobolus rupestris
intro: Niphobolus rupestris, commonly known as Rock Cap or Rock Polypody, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and it is known to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which provide several health benefits, including wound healing, anti-aging, and immune system support. The therapeutic actions of Niphobolus rupestris include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial effects, which make it useful in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
